children: 1618 ET - Livestock futures rise to start the week with boxed beef and pork cutout prices both reported higher. Live cattle futures were supported by Friday's Cattle on Feed report showing the smallest placement on lots for August on record, as well as record-low marketings for the month. Cattle settle up 2.5% on CME at $2.22 a pound. Lean hogs rise 1.8% to 69.8 cents a pound. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
Livestock Futures Start Week With Gains — Market Talk

1618 ET - Livestock futures rise to start the week with boxed beef and pork cutout prices both reported higher. Live cattle futures were supported by Friday's Cattle on Feed report showing the smallest placement on lots for August on record, as well as record-low marketings for the month. Cattle settle up 2.5% on CME at $2.22 a pound. Lean hogs rise 1.8% to 69.8 cents a pound. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
